thread.title: As Apple announces new Austin campus, here’s a look at the biggest hiring announcements of the year

author: Steve Goldstein
title: As Apple announces new Austin campus, here’s a look at the biggest hiring announcements of the year
text:
Published: Dec 13, 2018 3:56 p.m. ET Share A view of buildings on the Apple campus in Cork, southern Ireland.
By Steve Goldstein D.C. bureau chief
Apple on Thursday announced it was building an Austin, Texas, campus, one of many hiring announcements made by companies across the nation.
Apple AAPL, +1.09% had in January announced plans to hire 20,000 workers, so the Texas campus plan is not actually a new hiring announcement.
Per outplacement firm Challenger, Gray & Christmas, here are the largest hiring announcements of 2018, excluding the seasonal job hiring from the likes of Target and UPS.
Amazon AMZN, -0.31% is not number-one on the list because the initial HQ2 hiring plan of 50,000 was announced in September 2017. But the Nashville operations center the company unveiled in October puts the Jeff Bezos-run company on the list for 2018.
Andrew Challenger, vice president for Challenger, Gray & Christmas, said the big job announcements tend to be either from technology giants making strategic shifts or retailers making a big seasonal push. Company
